newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 28.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie frees jailed and detained students as gesture to end campus unrest; permanent committee set up to ensure dialogue
- British business delegation and representatives of South Korean firm Daewoo Corporation hold separate talks with Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan
- Ivory Coast's MASA 97 African performing arts festival which begins on Saturday expected to attracted talent scouts from United States as well as Europe
- National Statistics Institute says it will conduct a national census on companies operating in Ivory Coast from March 3; first results expected by end of March.
- Ivorian banana producers and exporters association OCAB plans training programme to improve quality of the product
